title: Everyday touch
prompt: Holding hands, cuddling on the couch, casual physical closeness.

title: Talking desire
prompt: Naming what you want sexually without embarrassment.

title: Shared rhythm
prompt: Finding a sexual frequency that feels mutual, not negotiated as a chore.

title: Weekly check-ins
prompt: A recurring space to say how you actually feel.

title: Quick repair
prompt: Coming back after a sharp moment within the same day.

title: Soft landing
prompt: Being the safe place when the other is overwhelmed.

title: Idea sparring
prompt: Debating ideas for fun, not to win.

title: Learn together
prompt: Courses, books, or podcasts you take in as a pair.

title: Long-range plans
prompt: Talking five-year shapes of life with curiosity.

title: Shared ritual
prompt: A practice — religious or not — that marks meaning together.

title: Values alignment
prompt: Knowing what ‘a good life’ means to each of you.

title: Awe moments
prompt: Seeking beauty, nature, or silence on purpose.

title: Mini adventures
prompt: Spontaneous outings that break the weekday loop.

title: First-times
prompt: Trying something neither of you has done before.

title: Home as stage
prompt: Turning ordinary nights at home into something memorable.

title: Make things
prompt: Cooking, building, writing, or crafting side by side.

title: Playfulness
prompt: Inside jokes, bits, and silly modes that only you two share.

title: Solo studio time
prompt: Protecting each other’s creative focus without resentment.

title: Money openness
prompt: Talking numbers without shame or secrecy.

title: Shared goals
prompt: Saving or spending toward a goal you both named.

title: Clear roles
prompt: Knowing who tracks what — and rotating when needed.

title: Friend overlap
prompt: Having people you both enjoy as a unit.

title: Separate orbits
prompt: Supporting nights out that don’t include each other.

title: Hosting
prompt: Opening your home or table to others together.

title: Directness
prompt: Saying the hard thing without a week of frost.

title: Fair pauses
prompt: Taking a break mid-fight and actually returning.

title: Owning impact
prompt: Apologizing for effect, not only intent.

title: Shared taste at home
prompt: Caring how your shared spaces look and feel.

title: Style curiosity
prompt: Noticing and celebrating how the other dresses or presents.

title: Culture dates
prompt: Museums, films, music, or design as a date genre.
